title: Bug: test_vlan_ports_down need to be aligned for v6 only topology
author: JibinBao
body:

### Description of the bug
file: vlan/test_vlan_ports_down.py
When run t**est_vlan_ports_down** on t0-isolated-v6-d32u32s, it will raise the following error   
def test_vlan_ports_down(vlan_ports_setup, duthosts, rand_one_dut_hostname, nbrhosts, tbinfo, ptfadapter):
        """
        Asserts the following conditions when all member ports of a VLAN interface are down:
            1. The VLAN interface's oper status remains Up.
            2. The VLAN's subnet IP is advertised to the T1 neighbors.
            3. The IP decapsulation feature works for packets that are sent to the VLAN interfaces's IP address.
        """
        duthost = duthosts[rand_one_dut_hostname]
        vlan_name = vlan_ports_setup
        ip_interfaces = duthost.show_ip_interface()["ansible_facts"]["ip_interfaces"]
>       vlan_info = ip_interfaces[vlan_name]
E       KeyError: 'Vlan1000'

nbrhosts   = {'ARISTA01PT0': , 'ARISTA01T1': , 'ARISTA02PT0': , 'ARISTA09T1': , ...}
ptfadapter =

Need to align the test for v6 only topology

The test can be supported by v6 only topology

linkedPullRequests.title: Support IPv6-only topologies in test_vlan_ports_down
linkedPullRequests.author: yxieca
linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR

Summary:
`test_vlan_ports_down` unconditionally calls `show_ip_interface()` and accesses the VLAN by name, causing a `KeyError` on IPv6-only topologies (e.g. `t0-isolated-v6-d32u32s`) where the VLAN has no IPv4 address.

This PR makes the test dual-stack aware by making IPv4 and IPv6 checks conditional on address availability.

Fixes #21798

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [x] 202511

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

`test_vlan_ports_down` crashes with `KeyError: 'Vlan1000'` on IPv6-only topologies because `duthost.show_ip_interface()` only returns interfaces with IPv4 addresses. The VLAN exists but has no IPv4 address assigned.

#### How did you do it?

Made all three test phases (oper status, BGP route check, IP-in-IP decap) conditional on address family availability:
- Use `.get()` to safely check if the VLAN appears in IPv4/IPv6 interface lists
- Run oper status checks for whichever address families are present
- Run BGP route advertisement checks per available address family
- Skip the IP-in-IP decapsulation test on IPv6-only topologies (it requires an IPv4 destination)
- Fail explicitly if the VLAN has neither IPv4 nor IPv6

#### How did you verify/test it?

- Code review against the issue description and `show_ipv6_interfaces()` API
- flake8 lint pass (max-line-length=120)

#### Any platform specific information?

Applicable to any platform running IPv6-only topologies (e.g. `t0-isolated-v6-d32u32s`).

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?

N/A (bug fix)

### Documentation
N/A
